scope: Presentation and activity navigation only; no backend or dependency changes

demonstrated_defects.issue: View request carried a pending quote from a different saved task into All messages
demonstrated_defects.evidence: Manual in-app-browser reproduction; corrected regressions fail at quote count on previous production build at desktop and mobile
demonstrated_defects.fix: Clear pending excerpt on intentional activity navigation; preserve unsent draft and existing composer task target

demonstrated_defects.issue: Mobile activity table pushed the View request action beyond the visible table
demonstrated_defects.evidence: 390x844 automated screenshot from initial passing suite
demonstrated_defects.fix: Keep task, status and action columns on mobile; show origin/time below task name; assert action bounds and zero table overflow

refinements: Clear activity search preserves selected status filter and focuses input
Show all activity resets query/filter and focuses input without dispatch
Activity search focus style matches the message navigator; 16px mobile input
Saved-task count handles singular task and filtered list is labeled Search results

earlier_browser_suite.limitation: Offscreen mobile table action was identified in screenshot afterward; stronger assertion and corrected layout verified by final run

before_fix_regressions.expected_failure: Quote review count expected zero, observed one

checks.test_setup_note: Initial exact saved-row selector ignored the row date metadata; that interrupted attempt was not counted as a product failure. Corrected selector established the actual quote regression.

checks.backend_tests: not rerun this frontend-only pass; previous 55-test result retained

manual_final_observations: Activity View request focuses its exact user message and removes pending reminder quote
Unsent text preserved after View request
Clear search focuses input and keeps Needs review filter
Show all activity restores All filter and three loaded receipts
Escape restores Activity trigger focus and saved-task reading context
